name: k-vault
description: K-Vault - Free File Hosting Service based on Telegram

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('No build step required. For Cloudflare Pages Git integration, leave Build command and Build output directory empty.')"
scripts.start: npx wrangler pages dev ./ --kv "img_url" --r2=R2_BUCKET --compatibility-date=2026-05-03 --port 8080 --binding BASIC_USER=admin --binding BASIC_PASS=123 --persist-to ./data
scripts.test: node scripts/test-file-record.mjs && node scripts/test-file-record-upload.mjs && node scripts/test-list-d1.mjs && node scripts/test-quota.mjs && node scripts/test-folders-shares.mjs && node scripts/test-bundles.mjs && node scripts/test-schema.mjs
